core: Cytosolic dsRNA sensing driving type I interferon induction
qualifier: RIG-I/MDA5 positive regulation via IRF3
name: RIG-I/MDA5 dsRNA sensing and IRF3-driven type I interferon
rationale: All members concern cytosolic dsRNA sensing by RIG-I/MDA5 and the IRF3-dependent induction of type I interferon, whereas confusables carry broader RLR/NF-kB, negative-regulator or cGAS/IFN-beta response content.

core: Contact activation and von Willebrand factor function
qualifier: FXII/kallikrein and VWF variant defects rather than downstream cascade factors
name: Contact activation system and von Willebrand factor variants
rationale: Members cover FXII/plasma kallikrein contact activation (intrinsic pathway, hereditary angioedema, amyloid-triggered FXII) and VWF/GPIb/ADAMTS13 variants, distinguishing it from confusables built on F8/F9/FV defects, fibrin formation and fibrinolysis.

core: Pyruvate and TCA cycle intermediate metabolism
qualifier: with di- and tricarboxylate membrane transport
name: Pyruvate and TCA intermediate metabolism with carboxylate transport
rationale: Members span pyruvate handling, TCA cycle, malate-aspartate shuttle and transport of di/tricarboxylates and organic anions; the transport arm separates it from purely metabolic confusables and the metabolic arm from SLC-transport confusables.

qualifier: netrin signaling and DSCAM/Sidekick self-avoidance
name: Netrin signaling and DSCAM/Sidekick neurite self-avoidance
rationale: All members concern guidance of axons and dendrites through netrin signaling and DSCAM/SDK-mediated self-avoidance, which the ephrin/L1/Slit and chemorepulsion confusables lack.

qualifier: triggered by hydrogen peroxide, oxidative stress or hypoxia
name: Regulation of oxidative stress- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Every member regulates intrinsic apoptotic or programmed cell death triggered by H2O2/oxidative stress or hypoxia, unlike confusables about MOMP, respiration or general peroxide responses.

qualifier: in the thymus: thymocyte selection, survival and central tolerance
name: Thymic T cell development, selection and central tolerance
rationale: Members describe thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis, migration, positive/negative selection and self-tolerance, separating the theme from bone-marrow hematopoiesis and peripheral T cell activation confusables.

core: Inflammatory mediator G protein-coupled receptor signaling
qualifier: histamine, P2Y nucleotide and eicosanoid receptors
name: Histamine, P2Y nucleotide and eicosanoid receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover GPCRs and responses for histamine, ATP/P2Y nucleotides, prostanoids and leukotrienes; the histamine and purinergic receptor content distinguishes it from eicosanoid-synthesis and PLC/calcium confusables.

qualifier: by deadenylation at the maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Maternal mRNA deadenylation and decay at maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: All members concern deadenylation-driven degradation of maternal transcripts during the maternal-to-zygotic transition, unlike general decapping/decay or MZT chromatin confusables.

qualifier: plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin production
name: B cell to plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulins
rationale: Members are B cell and plasma cell/immunoglobulin modules plus plasma cell differentiation, which distinguishes the theme from memory, germinal-centre and naive B cell confusables.

core: Regulation of antibody-Fc receptor effector responses
qualifier: ADCC, type II hypersensitivity and acute antigen-driven inflammation
name: Antibody-Fc receptor effector regulation, ADCC and type II hypersensitivity
rationale: Members regulate circulating-immunoglobulin effector functions through activating/inhibitory Fc receptors, ADCC, phagocytosis and type II hypersensitivity, while confusables center on FCGR phagocytic machinery, neutrophil degranulation or B cell receptor inhibition.

core: Cancer mutants in TGF-beta and Wnt transcriptional effectors
qualifier: TGFBR2, SMAD MH2 domain and TCF7L2 mutants
name: Cancer mutants of TGFBR2, SMAD MH2 domains and TCF7L2
rationale: All members are cancer-associated mutant forms of TGFBR2, SMAD2/3/4 MH2 domains or TCF7L2, unlike confusables covering TGFBR1/phosphomotif mutants, mismatch repair, normal TGF-beta signaling or Hippo.

core: Small RNA biogenesis and RNA silencing
qualifier: with negative regulation of splicing and mRNA processing
name: miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing with splicing regulation
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA processing, RISC assembly and small-RNA/lncRNA silencing plus regulation of splicing, distinguishing it from mRNA-stability, nuclear processing and gene-specific miRNA translation confusables.

qualifier: NGF production and p75NTR death/survival signaling
name: NGF production and p75NTR death and survival signaling
rationale: Members concern NGF/proNGF processing and p75NTR complex recruitment, proteolysis, NRIF/NADE death and NF-kB survival signaling, which TRKA, dependence-receptor and axon-regeneration confusables lack.

core: Lipid-linked glycan carrier and anchor biosynthesis
qualifier: dolichyl phosphate and GPI anchor
name: Dolichyl-phosphate and GPI anchor biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of dolichyl phosphate/dolichol-linked oligosaccharides or GPI anchor synthesis and attachment, unlike confusables on nucleotide sugars, glycosphingolipids or mannose-CDG defects.

qualifier: adhesion via VWF-GPIb and collagen, agonist receptors, degranulation and aggregation
name: Platelet adhesion, activation, degranulation and aggregation
rationale: Members span platelet adhesion (VWF/GPIb, GPVI collagen), agonist receptor signaling (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane), degranulation and aggregation, distinct from coagulation-factor and generic G12/13-Rho confusables.

qualifier: transferrin, ferroportin and heme uptake and transport
name: Iron and heme transport in systemic iron homeostasis
rationale: Members cover transferrin cycling, iron import/export defects (SLC11A2, SLC40A1, ceruloplasmin) and heme scavenging, distinguishing them from heme biosynthesis, other-metal transport and scavenger-receptor confusables.

qualifier: transcription and primary/precursor processing
name: Regulation of miRNA transcription and processing
rationale: All members regulate miRNA transcription or pri-/pre-miRNA processing, upstream of the RISC silencing, miRNA decay and target-translation content in confusables.

qualifier: chemotaxis, extravasation and activation
name: Monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation and inflammatory activation
rationale: Members concern monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation, aggregation and inflammatory activation, which confusables on endothelial adhesion, chemokine clusters or monocyte surface signatures do not share as a whole.

qualifier: non-pigmentation target programs
name: MITF-M regulation and its non-pigmentation target programs
rationale: All members concern MITF-M regulation and its target genes for proliferation, invasion, metabolism, DNA repair and lysosomes, while confusables center on pigmentation, melanin and PAX3/CDH1 transcription.

qualifier: oxidative N-demethylation of aromatic amines and alkaloids
name: Oxidative demethylation in xenobiotic and alkaloid catabolism
rationale: Members concern oxidative xenobiotic and alkaloid breakdown including CYP1A2 N-dealkylation and oxidative demethylation, distinguishing it from conjugation (acetylation, methylation, sulfonation) and FMO confusables.

core: Centriole and primary cilium cycle regulation
qualifier: basal body anchoring, cilium assembly/disassembly and centriole duplication
name: Centriole duplication and primary cilium assembly-disassembly regulation
rationale: Members regulate centriole elongation, centrosome duplication, basal body docking and cilium assembly or disassembly, unlike confusables on intraflagellar transport, mitotic spindle centrosomes or MTOC anchoring.

qualifier: fermentation to lactate and fructose bisphosphate metabolism
name: Glucose fermentation to lactate and fructose bisphosphate metabolism
rationale: Most members describe glycolysis from hexokinase through fructose-1,6/2,6-bisphosphate to lactate fermentation (oxygen transport and resveratrol response are outliers), distinguishing it from PPP/glycolysis regulation, gluconeogenesis and creatine confusables.

core: Viral evasion by host immune receptor downregulation
qualifier: HIV Nef/Vpu targeting CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I
name: HIV Nef/Vpu-mediated downregulation of host immune surface receptors
rationale: Members center on HIV Nef/Vpu-driven ubiquitin/proteasome or endolysosomal removal of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I, unlike MHC-I presentation, HIV replication or PD-L1 degradation confusables.

qualifier: alpha-2/Gi-Gz suppression of catecholamine and insulin secretion
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/z signaling suppressing catecholamine and insulin secretion
rationale: All members concern alpha-2 adrenergic, Gi/Gz-mediated adenylate cyclase inhibition and its suppression of epinephrine, norepinephrine and insulin secretion, which generic cAMP/GPCR confusables lack.

core: Regulation of NF-kB transcription factor activity
qualifier: predominantly negative, including SUMOylation control
name: Negative regulation of NF-kB transcription factor activity and SUMOylation
rationale: Members largely restrain canonical and non-canonical NF-kB and transcription factor activity, with deubiquitination and SUMOylation control, distinguishing it from NF-kB activation (TLR/TNFR/IKK) and generic DUB confusables.
